ValidationRule.description: This VD does not allow the user to change the amount once a Transfer is made from the Commitment.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND(AllowChange__c = false, ISCHANGED( Commitment_Amount_nearest__c ), Has_Child__c =true), true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The commitment amount cannot be edited because a transfer has been made from this commitment. Please first delete the transfer made from this commitment and then edit the commitment amount.
